mcq.q: In the word 'hospital', which syllable is stressed?
mcq.explanation: We say HOS-pi-tal.

mcq.q: In the word 'emergency', which syllable is stressed?
mcq.explanation: We say e-MER-gen-cy.

mcq.q: In 'bandage', the stress is on
mcq.explanation: We say BAN-dage.

mcq.q: The noun 'present' (a gift) is stressed on
mcq.explanation: The noun is PRE-sent and the verb is pre-SENT.

mcq.q: The verb 'record' (to make a record) is stressed on
mcq.explanation: The verb is re-CORD.

mcq.q: First aid is
options: the first help given to a person who is hurt or ill
mcq.explanation: First aid is given before a doctor takes over.

mcq.q: An antiseptic is
options: a liquid or cream that kills germs on a wound
mcq.explanation: It cleans wounds by killing germs.

mcq.q: First aid words: Which word has the sound /aɪ/?
mcq.explanation: Bite has /aɪ/.

mcq.q: First aid words: Which word has the sound /ɒ/?
mcq.explanation: Doctor has the short vowel /ɒ/.

mcq.q: Which word starts with the cluster 'sn'?
mcq.explanation: Snake starts with s and n.

mcq.q: An underpass is
options: a path or road that goes under a busy road
mcq.explanation: Pedestrians can walk through it without meeting cars.

mcq.q: A roundabout is
options: a circular junction where vehicles go around in one direction
mcq.explanation: Traffic moves round a central island.

mcq.q: What does 'bleed' mean?
options: To lose blood from a cut
mcq.explanation: A bleeding wound loses blood.

mcq.q: A visual is something we
mcq.explanation: Pictures, signs, maps and videos are visuals.

mcq.q: In which direction does the sun rise?
mcq.explanation: The sun rises in the east.

mcq.q: In which direction does the sun set?
mcq.explanation: The sun sets in the west.

mcq.q: What does a foot bridge help people to do?
options: Cross a road safely by walking over it
mcq.explanation: It goes over the road.

mcq.q: What should you do at a railway crossing?
mcq.explanation: Trains cannot stop quickly.

mcq.q: On a map, the four main directions are
mcq.explanation: These are called the cardinal points.

mcq.q: On most maps, north is at the
mcq.explanation: North is shown at the top of a map.

mcq.q: A comic is a story told in
mcq.explanation: Comics use pictures, often with speech bubbles.

mcq.q: A caption is
mcq.explanation: Captions tell us what a picture shows.

mcq.q: A red octagon sign with the word STOP tells drivers to
mcq.explanation: A stop sign means stop.

mcq.q: If you face the rising sun, north is on your
mcq.explanation: The sun rises in the east. When you face east, north is on your left.

mcq.q: Which visual would help you find a place you have never been to?
mcq.explanation: A map shows where places are.

mcq.q: Which word is a pronoun?
mcq.explanation: She takes the place of a noun.

mcq.q: Which pronoun replaces 'Ali and I'?
mcq.explanation: We includes the speaker and another person.

mcq.q: Which pronoun replaces 'the children'?
mcq.explanation: They stands for more than one.

mcq.q: Which is an object pronoun?
mcq.explanation: Him is the object form of he.

mcq.q: Pronouns: Choose the correct sentence.
mcq.explanation: Me is the object form of I.

mcq.q: Which is a possessive pronoun?
mcq.explanation: Yours stands alone and shows ownership.

mcq.q: Complete: 'This bag is mine and that bag is ___.' (belonging to you)
mcq.explanation: Yours is the possessive pronoun for you.

mcq.q: Complete: 'Give the book to ___.' (Ann and Eve)
mcq.explanation: Them is the object form of they.

mcq.q: Pronouns: Which is correct?
options: Ali and me went to the clinic.
Me and Ali went to the clinic.
Ali and myself went to the clinic.
Ali and I went to the clinic.
mcq.explanation: I is the subject form.

mcq.q: Complete: 'That car belongs to my parents. It is ___.'
mcq.explanation: Theirs shows that the car belongs to them.

mcq.q: Which word goes before a noun to show ownership?
mcq.explanation: My comes before a noun. Mine stands alone.

mcq.q: Pronouns: Which sentence is correct?
mcq.explanation: Possessive pronouns are written without an apostrophe.

mcq.q: Where does the sender's address go in a friendly letter?
mcq.explanation: Address and date are at the top right.

mcq.q: What punctuation mark follows the greeting 'Dear Achieng'?
mcq.explanation: A comma follows the greeting.

mcq.q: Which closing is suitable for a friendly letter?
mcq.explanation: Yours lovingly is friendly.

mcq.q: A friendly letter is written to
mcq.explanation: A friendly letter is personal.

mcq.q: Which is a part of an SMS?
mcq.explanation: An SMS has a receiver, a message and a sender.

mcq.q: Which is a good rule for writing an SMS?
mcq.explanation: A good SMS is clear and polite.

mcq.q: Which is the correct order for the parts of a friendly letter?
options: Address and date, greeting, body, closing, name
mcq.explanation: This is the standard order.

mcq.q: Which sentence would be best in the body of a friendly letter?
mcq.explanation: It is a warm, friendly opening line.

mcq.q: Which is better for sharing a lot of news and feelings?
mcq.explanation: A letter can hold more news.

mcq.q: Which date form is correct in a letter?
mcq.explanation: The usual order is day, month, year.

mcq.q: Why should you use a mobile phone only with permission?
options: Phones are only for adults to own
It keeps you safe and responsible
It makes the battery last longer
mcq.explanation: A trusted adult can guide you.

mcq.q: Which word begins the greeting in a friendly letter?
mcq.explanation: Friendly letters begin with Dear and the name.

short.q: Explain what word stress is. Give one example.
short.answer: Word stress is the syllable we say more strongly in a word, for example the first syllable in HOS-pi-tal.
short.working: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for the example.

short.q: Write one sentence using 'present' as a noun and one using 'present' as a verb. Show the stress with capital letters.
short.answer: My uncle gave me a PRE-sent. I will pre-SENT the prize to the winner.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for correct stress.

short.q: Write three sentences you would say to report an accident to an adult.
short.answer: For example: Help! There is an emergency. A boy has fallen and his arm is bleeding. Please bring the first aid kit.
short.working: 1 mark for each clear sentence.

short.q: Explain why it is important to put the stress on the right syllable.
short.answer: Wrong stress can make a word hard to understand, and it can change the word from a noun to a verb.
short.working: 1 mark for each reason.

short.q: Give the meaning of four words from the lesson: injury, treatment, painkiller, poison.
short.answer: Injury: harm done to the body. Treatment: care given to a sick person. Painkiller: medicine that reduces pain. Poison: something that can make you very ill or kill you.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Name two visuals you can find in a newspaper.
short.answer: Any two: photographs, cartoons, maps, charts, advertisements.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Describe the steps to interpret a picture.
short.answer: Look at the whole picture, read the caption, notice details and expressions, think what is happening and what will happen next.
short.working: 1 mark for each of three steps.

short.q: Write directions to walk from the school to the market on the map in the lesson.
short.answer: Walk east to the roundabout, go straight east across the foot bridge and you will reach the market.
short.working: 1 mark for east, 1 mark for the roundabout and 1 mark for the foot bridge and market.

short.q: Why is it important to interpret road signs correctly?
short.answer: Signs warn us of danger and tell us what to do, so misunderstanding one could cause an accident.
short.working: 1 mark for what signs do and 1 mark for the danger of misunderstanding.

short.q: Write four sentences using north, south, east and west to describe the position of places near your school.
short.answer: For example: The gate is south of the classroom. The field is east of the gate. The library is west of the field. The road is north of the school.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

short.q: Replace the second mention with a pronoun: 'Neema saw the bridge. Neema liked the bridge.'
short.answer: Neema saw the bridge. She liked it.
short.working: 1 mark for she and 1 mark for it.

short.q: Explain the difference between 'my' and 'mine'. Use each in a sentence.
short.answer: My comes before a noun (This is my bag). Mine stands alone (The bag is mine).
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for the difference.

short.q: Write the subject and the object forms of: I, he, we, they.
short.answer: I, me; he, him; we, us; they, them.
short.working: Half a mark for each pair.

short.q: Write three sentences about a car near a bridge using one subject pronoun, one object pronoun and one possessive pronoun.
short.answer: It has bright head lights. The bridge protects us. The car is theirs.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Correct the sentences: (a) 'Him is a driver.' (b) 'Give the pen to she.' (c) 'The bag is mine bag.'
short.answer: (a) He is a driver. (b) Give the pen to her. (c) The bag is mine. / It is my bag.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the greeting and closing for a friendly letter to your friend Wanjiku.
short.answer: Dear Wanjiku, ... Yours lovingly, (your name).
short.working: 1 mark for the greeting with comma and 1 mark for the closing.

short.q: List the five parts of a friendly letter.
short.answer: Address, date, greeting, body, closing and name (address and date may be given together).
short.working: 1 mark for address and date, 1 mark for greeting and body, 1 mark for closing and name.

short.q: Write an SMS inviting a friend to your birthday party on Saturday at 3 o'clock.
short.answer: Hi Kamau. Please come to my birthday party on Saturday at 3 o'clock at my home. Thank you. Ann.
short.working: 1 mark for greeting, 1 for day, time and place, 1 for politeness and name.

short.q: Give two differences between a friendly letter and an SMS.
short.answer: A letter is longer and has five parts, but an SMS is short and has a receiver, a message and a sender. A letter is better for news and feelings.
short.working: 1 mark for each difference.

short.q: Write a friendly letter of about five sentences to a friend in another school about new road safety words you learnt.
short.answer: A letter with address and date, Dear ..., a body that mentions words such as roundabout, foot bridge and railway crossing, a closing and a name.
short.working: 1 mark for address and date, 1 for greeting, 1 for body content, 1 for closing and name, 1 for punctuation.
